decision.summary: No management action and no valid new BTC price-hit entry this cycle.
decision.rationale: There are no open positions to close or reduce, and reconciliation, equity, and daily cooldown gates are healthy. Latest Beecthor context allows an upside sweep toward 81k-85k before a later bearish turn, but Binance is neutral at 80012 after a +1443 USD UTC-day move, so the playbook cooling rule blocks bullish reach entries. Bearish DIP entries lack Binance rejection confirmation and are blocked by the bearish-bias correction; weekly markets do not have clean enough execution confirmation to override those gates.
